expected.qualification: Inject crash immediately after durable intent, before send. Restart uses the same persisted response; original expiry still bounds retry. E1/E2 worker implementation is required. One durable intent per grant; RELEASE_SENT records each attempted send, including retries. Token/ciphertextDigest stay identical; delivery remains unknown. A separate expired retry emits no new worker event and returns EXPIRED. D35/A38: paper response recipient is RSC.recipientKeyHash(grant.gid), while the native DBC grant recipient remains zero. Verify the registered key exists. Release and any pre-expiry retry must occur strictly before policyEnf DBC block timestamp + 30 seconds (A24); set injected DBC time explicitly and retain the block/expiry. A later receipt never extends release expiry. Current production owner still refuses paper grants; option-(c) spike evidence is not an integrated case result.
